CustomObject.label: OI Scan Object Scope
CustomObject.description: Explicit per-object overrides for which SObjects the metadata scan persists into the graph (ADR-0031). Enabled = true always includes the object (the shipped records are the core CRM objects); Enabled = false always excludes it, even if it is a customized object. Objects with no record here fall back to the OI_Settings__mdt scope switches.
